# Change Order Proposal: CRM Connector

**To:** Client Sponsor
**Subject:** Additional CRM connector (not in original scope)

## Background

The signed original scope covers the reporting dashboard. The client has requested an additional CRM connector, which is not included in the original fee.

## Requested Work

Design and build a CRM connector as an addition to the reporting dashboard scope.

## Price

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Estimated effort | 40 hours |
| Rate | $175/hour |
| Proposed fixed change fee | $7,000 |

## Schedule Effect

- The connector adds approximately two weeks after both of the following occur: written approval of this change order and receipt of sandbox credentials.
- This is an estimate, not an approved calendar date.

## Client Dependency

The client must provide sandbox credentials before connector work can proceed.

## Approval

Connector work will not begin until the sponsor approves this change order in writing.

| Decision | Selection |
|---|---|
| ☐ Approve | Sponsor signature / date: ____________ |
| ☐ Decline | Sponsor signature / date: ____________ |
